2607.28955.title: Retrieval-Driven Training-Free AI-Generated Video Attribution
2607.28955.paper_summary: AI-generated videos are becoming increasingly realistic and difficult to distinguish from authentic ones, which facilitates malicious misuse and poses growing threats to cybersecurity and social governance. Attributing AI-generated videos to their specific generative sources is therefore of critical importance for forensic investigation and legal regulation. However, most existing visual attribution methods focus on images and particularly rely on the image generation model, thereby lacking the ability to generalize to large-scale AI-generated video data. To address these limitations, we introduce an training-free AI-generated video attribution paradigm. Specifically, we formulates AI-generated video attribution as an instance retrieval task, and design a generative fingerprint-based pipeline. This pipeline consists of an adapted orthogonal color transformation, multi-scale quantized residual generation, and temporal-semantic aggregation, progressively capturing and integrating artifacts introduced by generative models across video frames. Extensive experiments on the GenVidBench benchmark demonstrate that our method achieves strong performance in both AI-generated video detection and attribution, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods with a Rank-1 accuracy of 20.5% and a mean Average Precision of 16.6%. The code is at https://github.com/renxi-seu/Video_Attribution.
2607.28955.paper_summary_zh: AI 生成的視頻變得越來越真實，並且難以與真實視頻區分，這促進了惡意濫用並對網絡安全和社會治理構成日益增長的威脅。因此，將 AI 生成的視頻歸因於其特定的生成來源對於法醫調查和法律監管至關重要。然而，大多數現有的視覺歸因方法專注於圖像，並特別依賴於圖像生成模型，因此缺乏對大規模 AI 生成視頻數據的泛化能力。為了解決這些限制，我們引入了一種無需訓練的 AI 生成視頻歸因範式。具體而言，我們將 AI 生成視頻的歸因定義為一個實例檢索任務，並設計了一個基於生成指紋的管道。該管道由一個適應性的正交顏色變換、多尺度量化殘差生成和時間-語義聚合組成，逐步捕捉和整合生成模型在視頻幀中引入的工件。在 GenVidBench 基準上的廣泛實驗表明，我們的方法在 AI 生成視頻檢測和歸因方面表現出色，超越了現有的最先進方法，達到了 20.5% 的 Rank-1 準確率和 16.6% 的平均精確度。代碼位於 https://github.com/renxi-seu/Video_Attribution。
